name: secure-term
description: Seal a recovery key with a passphrase you cannot forget. AES-256-GCM, no server, no dependencies. Works in the browser and the terminal.
//engines: Node 20, not 18: Web Crypto is only a global from Node 19 unflagged and 20 stably, and everything here is built on it. Verified by running the suite on 18, where it fails.
//: The website is deliberately excluded from the published package: npm gets the shared core and the CLI, GitHub Pages serves the rest.
